Name: (CP) Farm Visible Corner
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Content Patcher conversion of Metalax's Farm Visible Corner so it no longer relies on TXML/PyTK

Edits the farm map to move the decorative trees on the border at the lower right corner of the map. This allows all accessible farm tiles to be visible.



[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2243832]metalax[/url]'s Original Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4844

Manifest.Name: (CP) Farm Visible Corner
Manifest.Description: Moves the decorative trees at the border in the lower right of the farm map, to allow all accessible tiles to be visible.
